title: Kaboom Library
description: A fabric library that i use for my mods
body:
# What is Kaboom?

This is a library that i use when making mods for the things i hate(rendering). The library adds 
new helper methods that makes my life easier.

# What it adds?

I have problems with rendering coding so i made this library for most of the rendering consepts.
Main things i added as helper methods:
- Screen:
    - Easier adding of: buttons, texts
- Hud Rendering:
    - Adds methods to help with adding widget, hud rendering
- World Rendering:
    - Makes easier rendering shapes and other things in the world or players screen

# Why would you need to download it?

If you want to play mods that i make in the future i will use this mods api to make it easier, so it would be required for them.

# Is Kaboom getting a wiki?

For now no. I use it only for me but if there is intrest i will make a wiki
